answer: One defence is a reputation terrace: new agents start on a low terrace with capped transaction limits and earn promotion only through sustained, verifiable work, so a raven-like swarm of fresh fake identities cannot jump straight to high-value deals. Promotion requires a ferrous bond, a refundable stake of tokens locked per identity, which makes each fake account cost real capital. An attacker cloning a thousand identities must lock a thousand stakes and wait out the same slow climb, turning cheap identity forgery into an expensive, slow grind.
